description: This file declares a ProxyServer class and related functions for establishing a TCP proxy within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides the interface for creating, running, and managing proxy server instances that forward data between client and target connections.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: A class that manages a TCP proxy server, handling setup via a server socket and client factory, and providing a method to join and wait for server termination.

methods.name: Proxy
methods.description: Function that runs a TCP proxy, accepting client connections and forwarding data between clients and target connections. Designed to run indefinitely unless the server is closed externally.

methods.name: ProxyAsync
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a ProxyServer object that runs the TCP proxy asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyServer::ProxyServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the proxy server with a server socket and a client factory callback.

methods.name: ProxyServer::Join
methods.description: Blocks until the proxy server thread terminates.
